verdicts.reason: Both use the same stacked layout with the same flaws: the hero product bag is shrunk into a small cropped square, and an oversized logo roundel sits beside it as a competing focal point. The logo and badge are no longer grouped the way they are in the original. A has better spacing, but its CTA pill is small and left-aligned, so it reads as an afterthought under the huge headline. B's full-width CTA gives the action proper weight, but B is cramped: 'on repeat' almost touches the image row, and the body copy is jammed right under the images.
